title: Promote a supporting question to an output
description:
A sub-question turned out to be worth reporting; make it an output and start labeling it.

Current: no path; extend_cyclotron adds existing classifier definitions only (cyclotrons.py:54-68); supporting questions have no labels (classifier_config.py:88-95).

Desired: a command creates a new output from a supporting question's instructions and options; it starts unlabeled; the old supporting question stays until replaced.

Acceptance: a new cyclotron version gains the output; earlier evidence kept; first rubric from the question's instructions; parent's features unchanged until a candidate is promoted.
